title: Resident Down
core: Emergency response, resident assessment, and appropriate action after a fall.

quiz.why: Assess the resident for injuries before attempting to move them.

title: Title 22: Read It. Interpret It. Apply It.
core: Regulatory interpretation, administrator judgment, resident rights, documentation, and defensible compliance decisions.

quiz.why: Strong administrators identify the issue, gather the facts, verify the authority, apply it to the facts, and document the decision.

title: When Licensing Walks In
core: Licensing visits, records, staff interviews, deficiencies, plans of correction, and compliance systems.

quiz.why: The administrator should preserve accurate records, cooperate professionally, correct immediate risks, and address the underlying system.

title: The Admission Decision
core: Medical information, preplacement appraisal, admission suitability, resident needs, and initial service planning.

quiz.why: A safe admission decision requires complete information, appraisal of actual needs, and confirmation that the facility can provide the required care and supervision.

title: Can This Resident Stay?
core: Change of condition, reappraisal, revised service planning, retention decisions, and facility capacity.

quiz.why: Changes in resident needs require reassessment and service-plan review rather than relying on outdated admission information.
